stories.title: U.S. strikes three Iranian oil tankers in renewal of hostilities
stories.summary: The U.S. strikes three Iranian oil tankers after Iran targets two American warships, in the latest exchange over shipping and the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: This is the work of our lifetime: Ayana Elizabeth Johnson urges action after new UN climate report
stories.summary: A United Nations report has found that the world will warm to 1.5 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels. Climate solutions advocate Ayana Elizabeth Johnson urges a quicker implementation of known strategies - and determination rather than despair.

stories.title: Flock cameras draw opposition from across the political spectrum
stories.summary: As political races heat up heading into the midterms, candidates from both parties are increasingly joining the fray to voice concerns over Flock surveillance cameras.

stories.title: Jazz legend John Coltrane's Philadelphia house to become a cultural heritage site
stories.summary: On the centennial of father's birth, Ravi Coltrane talks about turning the home where the jazz legend spent a crucial period in the 1950s into a cultural heritage and community space.

stories.title: A stranger helped a mother and son stuck in a current in Lake Michigan
stories.summary: A mother was caught in a current while saving her son in Lake Michigan. When she couldn't get them closer to shore, a man appeared to help.

stories.title: U.S. Forest Service to keep some research stations open, after pushback about restructuring
stories.summary: In a massive restructuring under the Trump administration, U.S. Forest Service is closing dozens of research stations but, as NPR's Chiara Eisner reports, it is keeping some facilities open that had been projected to shutter.
